caption: A perforated stainless-steel steamer insert cradles several bright-red cooked lobsters, their claws bound with green and tan ties, set inside a larger dark pan against a smudged grey metal wall. Wisps of steam curl upward from the tray, their shape and density shifting continuously while the lobsters remain still relative to the metal. One large body lies across the centre, a deep-red tail rests toward the lower right, and claw clusters bunch at the left. The framing drifts slowly, shifting the tray and its contents leftward and lifting the far rim higher. As this drift progresses, a second, empty, bright metal pan enters view along the right edge. Exposure shifts modestly, darkening before the newly revealed pan catches more light. The lobsters keep their fixed positions relative to one another and to the tray walls. Steam continues rising and the tray appears to shift toward the left edge.
